video_title: Fabolous On Working With Lil Wayne, Wanting A Bar-Heavy Drake Project & His Approach To Features

quotes.speaker: Fabolous
quotes.summary_phrase: Fabolous wants a bar-heavy project from Drake
quotes.excerpt: I want a whole project of that from him
quotes.quote: Off the top of my head, I would say Drake. I think Drake, when he makes projects, he has to cover all those bases too. But Drake will also have a song or two that is just him going bar-crazy. I want a whole project of that from him. I know the girls are going to be a little upset that you are not giving them their joint, but I want a whole project of that from him.

quotes.speaker: Fabolous
quotes.summary_phrase: Fabolous on his approach to guest features on songs
quotes.excerpt: I always represent myself to the highest level

text_blocks.speaker: Fabolous
text_blocks.text: My approach is to always represent myself to the highest level. I do not ever want to be like, 'He gave you a throwaway verse.' And I also feel like with a feature, they are calling you to bring more to the song. They did what they did and they want to add to it. So I always approach it that way. I want to add something to the song and not just be on the song.

text_blocks.speaker: Fabolous
text_blocks.text: Yeah, so I always kind of approach it that way. I want to add something to the song and not just be on the song.

quotes.speaker: Fabolous
quotes.summary_phrase: How hearing a verse or hook influences Fabolous's writing
quotes.excerpt: I like the music to dictate how you do it, what flow you are going to use
quotes.quote: Sometimes if they have a verse or hook, they will send you just the beat and tell you. So I am like, 'What is this song about? What do I do?' Hearing their verse or the hook can give you a direction on which way you want to go. I like to be inspired by whatever the music is because that takes you, that lets the music dictate where you are going to go. I like the music to dictate how you do it, what flow you are going to use, what how deep you want to touch on a subject, or just speak on everything all in once.
